process.title: From a seed of an idea to a website in fruit.
process.lead: Five steps, about five weeks. You always know what happens next and what you'll get at the end of each step.

stages.name: Seed
stages.text: You write a few lines about your business and what the website must do. No preparation needed.
stages.get: a reply within one working day

stages.name: Sprout
stages.text: I design how your site would look on desktop and phone. You pay nothing for this.

stages.name: Leaves
stages.text: If you like the draft, we agree on the fixed price, the pages and the content. You get one short list of what I need from you.
stages.get: a fixed price and a one-page plan

stages.name: Blossom
stages.text: I build every page, fast and mobile-first, with forms and search engine basics.
stages.get: a test link for your phone

stages.name: Fruit
stages.text: Your site goes live on your domain. I show you how to edit it, and I stay on hand afterwards.

process.insideHtml: Did you know figs flower on the inside? The blossom is hidden in the fruit. A good website is the same: the careful work you never see (speed, search engines, accessibility) is what makes it sweet for your visitors.

affordable.title: An affordable website, without cutting corners.
affordable.lead: Affordable doesn't mean a template or half-finished work. I can keep prices low because you work with me directly, so you don't pay for agency overheads, sales staff or project managers.

points.title: No agency mark-up
points.text: You pay for design and build, not for middlemen.

points.title: A fixed price, up front
points.text: After the design draft you get the exact price, and it doesn't change. No hourly rates, no surprises on the invoice.

points.title: Built for phones and Google
points.text: A good price still means a fast, mobile-friendly, search-friendly site, Google Business profile included.

affordable.closing: Whether you need a one-page website (landing page), a business website or a site with online booking, you always get the price in writing before any work starts.

faq.title: Asked before every first project.
faq.lead: Something else on your mind? Just write to me, answers are free and there's no obligation.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: A one-page website starts from {seedlingPrice}, a business website with up to 6 pages from {ripePrice}, and the version with booking and a blog from {grovePrice}. You get the exact, fixed price after the free design draft, and it doesn't change after that.

items.question: Do I have to pay before I see anything?
items.answer: No. First I make a free design draft. If you like it, we agree on the fixed price and only then do you pay. If you don't, you owe nothing.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: A one-page website takes about 2 weeks, a business website 4–5 weeks, and the version with extras 6–7 weeks. You get the design draft in the first week.

items.question: Why are you cheaper than an agency?
items.answer: Because you work with me directly: there are no sales staff, project managers or agency overheads built into the price. You pay for design and build, and I don't compromise on quality.

items.question: Do I need to prepare anything?
items.answer: No. Write a few lines about your business and your customers. I'll ask the questions.

items.question: What if I don't have photos or texts?
items.answer: I give you a short list of what's needed and help you write the texts. If you need photos, I can recommend a photographer.

items.question: Who owns the website and the domain?
items.answer: You do. The domain is registered in your name and you get all the logins at launch.

items.question: Can I change things myself later?
items.answer: Yes. You get a short video guide for editing texts, prices and photos. For bigger changes there are the monthly plans.

items.question: Can my site have online booking or a blog?
items.answer: Yes. The Fig grove package includes a calendar with appointment booking, embedded Google Maps and a blog.

items.question: Will people find me on Google?
items.answer: Every site gets the search engine basics: page titles, descriptions, fast loading and a Google Business profile.

items.question: Can we work together wherever I am in Hungary?
items.answer: Yes. Everything happens by email and online, so I can build a website for a business anywhere, from Budapest to Szeged.

contact.title: Let's plant the seed.
contact.lead: Write me two sentences about your business and what your website should do. I'll reply within one working day and we'll get started on your free design draft.
contact.note: I work by email, so everything we agree stays in writing.
